baseline.name: PICO-8 runtime API Reference
baseline.scope: Canonical named functions documented in API Reference sections 6.1–6.14, plus sgn documented in the syntax primer. Include runtime cartridge lifecycle/filesystem and advanced Lua functions; exclude four host/editor command functions below. Input-device GPIO/mouse/keyboard facilities expressed via peek/poke/stat share those API rows; their subfeatures are not counted twice.
baseline.denominator_policy: One row per canonical name, not per alias or overload. time/t count once; overloads affect status, never denominator. Callback hooks _init/_update/_update60/_draw and syntax are measured separately. ipairs is a converter extension not counted in this official inventory.

excluded.name: resume
excluded.reason: Interactive shell command to resume stopped execution.

rubric.implemented_partial: Functional implementation exists for some behaviors. Not a claim of complete semantics or official-equivalent results.
rubric.missing: No implementation, or accepted silent no-op (sfx/music).
rubric.complete: Reserved for independently reference-verified full promised semantics; no rows meet this bar.
rubric.capability_status: supported means no specific semantic omission identified by this code audit; partial means a known API behavior is absent or approximated; missing means no functional implementation. These labels are independent of reference-equivalence validation and do not mean production-complete.

summary.warning: Name presence percentage is not project completion, API semantic fidelity, games compatibility or estimated remaining effort.
